title: PLAID-PRF: Pseudo-Relevance Feedback with Centroid-like Tokens in PLAID
question: How can pseudo-relevance feedback be applied to ColBERT-style multi-vector retrieval using quantised centroid vectors so that query reformulation stays computationally cheap?

title: Information Bottleneck Learning for Faithful Time Series Forecasting Explanations
question: How can a multivariate time-series forecaster be built so that its explanations, which highlight the sparse subset of historical inputs driving each prediction, are provably faithful to the model's actual computation, while still matching the error of black-box models and letting users set the sparsity level directly?

title: CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models
question: How can large language models be prompted or trained to avoid contradictory relation predictions, such as violating transitivity, symmetry, or functional uniqueness, when extracting relations across a whole document?

title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
question: How much can a coding agent's prompt and completion tokens be reduced by pruning tool outputs using a lightweight head on the agent's own internal representations, and does this pruning preserve or even improve task performance?

title: Open-Source LLM-Driven Formal Verification: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for RTL Repair
question: What failure modes arise when an LLM is paired with open-source formal tools (Yosys, SymbiYosys, Z3) to iteratively repair RTL using counterexample feedback, and how often does each occur across a set of benchmark designs?

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping
question: What is the benefit of using training-only privileged skills to produce token-level credit signals for multi-turn LLM agents, compared with relying only on sparse trajectory-level rewards?

title: Interpretable MEG Decoding of Perceived Speech: Cortical Sources and the Stimulus Features That Drive Retrieval
question: What spatial and temporal modifications to a MEG-to-audio retrieval model, such as spherical-harmonic spatial encoding on the helmet geometry and a shallower decoder, let the learned weights be interpreted in source space while keeping high Top-1 retrieval accuracy among many speech candidates?

title: Beyond Local Inspection: Global, Guideline-Grounded Evaluation of Post-hoc XAI Methods for ECG Classification
question: How do gradient-based XAI methods transferred from computer vision compare in their ability to attribute relevance to clinically defined ECG regions, such as the ST segment for ischemia, when a classifier is trained on PTB-XL?

title: PaletteID: Prototype-Composed Semantic Identifiers for Multimodal CTR Prediction
question: How does constructing a prototype palette from representative items, rather than discretizing multimodal embeddings into hierarchical codes, affect CTR prediction accuracy for long-tail items compared with residual semantic ID methods?

title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
question: How does selectively encoding only dynamic, high-entropy regions of video using codec motion vectors and residual energy, rather than uniformly sampling frames, reduce visual token consumption while preserving spatiotemporal context in a streaming vision-language model?

title: Translation as a Computationally Efficient Bridge: Feasibility of English BERT for Low-Resource Languages
question: Does translating non-English datasets into English and fine-tuning an English BERT model match or beat fine-tuning a native-language BERT model, and for which tasks and languages does this translation-based approach work best?

title: When Replanning Becomes the Bottleneck: Budgeted Replanning for Embodied Agents
question: What token-pruning and budgeting approach can keep LLM-based replanning latency within real-time deadlines for embodied agents, given that accumulated context causes heavy-tailed latency spikes even when task success stays high?

title: Alternating Levenberg-Marquardt Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Fourier-Enhanced Features
question: How can a PINN be trained so that it avoids spectral bias and the entanglement of basis learning with coefficient fitting, and still accurately solve high-frequency or strongly nonlinear PDEs?

title: Entity-Faithful Repair of Synthetic Supervision for Zero-Shot Image Captioning
question: How can synthetic image-text pairs for zero-shot captioning be made more faithful by explicitly correcting entity-level misalignments, such as missing objects or misattributed attributes, rather than relying only on global image-text similarity?

title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
question: What effect does training on explicit chain-of-thought state transition modeling have on a model's ability to generalize planning to longer horizons than it saw during pre-training, compared with training on atomic skills or on suboptimal trajectories?

title: string2string Studio: An Interactive, In-Browser Platform for String-to-String Algorithms
question: How does compiling a string-analysis library's C++ algorithms to WebAssembly let an in-browser tool run alignment, distance, and BLAST-style homology search locally with speedups over its Python predecessor, without requiring installation or uploading data?

title: Fast, accurate, and differentiable: a neural-network surrogate for NRSur7dq4 precessing binary black hole waveforms
question: Could a neural-network surrogate of the precessing NRSur7dq4 waveform model match its accuracy across the full mass-ratio and spin range while running fast enough, and be differentiable enough, to support gradient-based gravitational-wave parameter estimation?

title: Generalization and Trade-off in Adversarial Training: An RKHS Perspective via Kernel Integral Operators
question: What generalization rate does adversarial training in an RKHS achieve, and can a two-stage noise-debiasing procedure that removes the noise contribution from the mixed robustness term recover the minimax rate?

title: MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing
question: How do the success, cost, and latency tradeoffs of a task-aware compositional routing policy compare with a strong static policy and simpler routing approaches for agentic systems, and does removing verification or restricting route composition cause the largest performance losses?

title: Query-Focused Event Summarization: A Dataset and Benchmark
question: How can a two-stage framework combining adaptive-threshold retrieval with hierarchical-clustering-based summarization generate query-focused summaries over large thematic corpora of thousands of documents more effectively than existing query-focused summarization methods?
